sloka: अद्य मे कुशलं देव अद्य मे कुशलं व्रतम् ।अद्य मे सफलं जन्म अद्य मे सफलं तपः ।यस्माद्देवगणैर्वन्द्यौ वन्दे ऽहं चरणौ तव ।। ७.३३.११ ॥
transliteration: adya me kuśalaṁ deva adya me kuśalaṁ vratam ।adya me saphalaṁ janma adya me saphalaṁ tapaḥ ।yasmāddevagaṇairvandyau vande 'haṁ caraṇau tava ।। 7.33.11 ॥

translations.english: O revered one, today is auspicious for me, my vow is fulfilled, my life is fruitful, and my penance is successful, because I bow to your feet, which are worshipped even by the hosts of gods.
translations.hindi: पुष्पपरागयुक्त मकरन्द की गन्ध सं भलाभात युक्त एव सुखदायी पवन, रावण का कामोदीपन करता हुआ वहने लगा
